QA-10 admin reconciliation of a cancelled captured payment credits the wallet
QA-11 concurrent add-to-cart requests preserve every increment
QA-12 a reset token can be used only once under concurrent requests
QA-13 parallel registration returns a conflict for a duplicate email

QA-15 two customers buying the last unit cannot oversell
